accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.lede: Kaushal Setu is meant for everyone who plans, teaches, hires or looks for work in Maharashtra.
accessibility.p1: We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA and the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW 3.0).
accessibility.p2: Every chart has a written summary and a table. The district map works with the keyboard and has a table beside it. Nothing needs dragging.
accessibility.p3: Text is at least 16px, focus is always visible, and the site works in English and Marathi, with reduced motion and high contrast honoured.
accessibility.p4: If something doesn't work for you, please tell us on the feedback page and say which page and device you used.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.lede: Tell us what's wrong, missing or confusing. A person reads every message.
feedback.p1: The feedback form is being set up. Until then, please share feedback through your district skill development office.
feedback.p2: If a number looks wrong, open its card and use the evidence drawer: tell us which row you disagree with.
